summary.text: Urson Russell is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 73 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Cottie Petrie-Norris.
He is a business executive who lists his profession as chief operating officer.

paragraphs.text: Urson Russell graduated from Newport Harbor High School.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a lifelong Southern Californian who has built businesses in operations, logistics and manufacturing for 30 years.
He said he co-founded a company that pioneered lithium golf car fleets, helped launch a wearable camera company and now produces reusable storage bags.
Russell advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary.
In the survey, he described himself as an advocate for accountability, limited government, public safety and economic freedom.
